title: SpaceX Announces Massive LA Launch Facility
summary: SpaceX Announces Massive $100 Billion "Starbase Louisiana" Launch Facility
content: PECAN ISLAND, LA — SpaceX has officially announced plans for its fourth and largest spaceport, "Starbase Louisiana," committing $100 billion to construct a massive manufacturing and launch hub in Vermilion Parish along the state's Gulf Coast.  The site will be significantly larger than SpaceX’s Starbase facility in Texas, aiming to support thousands of launches per year to handle upcoming Starship missions and orbital AI compute network deployments.

title: Kentucky Police Officer Arrested After Misusing Flock License Plate System to Track Ex Over 2,000 Times
summary: Kentucky Police Officer Arrested After Misusing Flock License Plate System to Track Ex Over 2,000 Times
content:
SHIVELY, Ky. — A Kentucky police officer was arrested and suspended without pay after authorities discovered he used the department’s Flock Safety automated license plate reader (ALPR) system to stalk his ex-girlfriend more than 2,000 times over a five-month span.

Officer Asad Zahir, 34, was taken into custody by the Shively Police Department following an internal investigation that revealed 2,048 unauthorized vehicle lookups between January and May.
